attchmntText: Aro Granite Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Aro Granite Industries Limited has published its audited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was issued on November 13, 2026. The company published these results in the Financial Express in all English editions and in Jansatta in Hindi. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document serves as a notice to the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India. It confirms that the financial results have been made public via newspaper advertisement. No other corporate actions or resolutions are mentioned in this specific filing.

attchmntText: Aro Granite Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aro Granite Industries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, as recommended by the Audit Committee. The company reported a net loss of 811.77 lacs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 739.00 lacs in the previous quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the net loss was 1,550.76 lacs, compared to 254.55 lacs in the corresponding period of the previous year. Revenue from operations stood at 1,816.87 lacs for the quarter and 3,937.60 lacs for the half year. The statutory auditor issued an unqualified opinion on the audited standalone financial results.
